about.title: About the house
about.text: A newly renovated townhouse with its own front door and no shared spaces. Two floors joined by a terrazzo staircase, a large roof terrace with an awning and sun loungers, and a private inner courtyard behind floor-to-ceiling glass. Three king bedrooms, a single room with a desk and a private loft room. Everything is set up for living here for weeks, not just sleeping: a full kitchen with an island, a living room with wooden beams and a 65-inch TV, and a laundry room for your kit.

items: We don’t rent bikes or run tours.

items.a: 11 nights. The house is set up for longer stays, from two weeks to the whole winter.
items.aMobile: 11 nights. The house is set up for longer stays, from two weeks to the whole winter.

items.a: Pick your dates here and you go straight to the Airbnb listing with dates and guests filled in. Airbnb handles the payment and protects your booking.
items.aMobile: Pick your dates and you go straight to Airbnb with dates and guests filled in.

items.q: Is the house warm in winter?
items.a: Yes. Every room has heating and air conditioning, and there’s a wood-burning fireplace in the dining area.
items.aMobile: Yes: heating and A/C in every room and a wood-burning fireplace.

items.q: Where do I keep my bike?
items.a: On a wall rack in secure indoor storage. There’s also a laundry room with a washer and dryer for your kit.
items.aMobile: On a wall rack in secure indoor storage.

items.q: Do you rent bikes or offer guided rides?
items.a: No. We share routes and local knowledge and point you to Maxima Bikes and Xabia’s Bike for rental and servicing.
items.aMobile: No. We point you to local shops for rental and servicing.

items.a: Yes. Fibre Wi-Fi at 302 Mbps and a dedicated workspace.

items.q: When is the best time for cycling?
items.a: October to May. December to February is pro training season; March and April bring longer days and orange blossom.
